title: The Right Coat
summary: Takemura takes you to a tailor in Heywood's Wellsprings, where you pick him a coat from three while the tailor prices it absurdly.
description: Takemura says a man with one coat is a man in trouble. He asks V to go with him to a tailor in Heywood's Wellsprings and pick him a coat from three.

start.bringUp: Takemura says he has one coat, that a man with one coat is a man in trouble, and asks you to accompany him to a tailor.

spot.name: the tailor boutique in Heywood's Wellsprings

g1.asks: Which of the three would Saburo have approved?
g1.know: Three coats are on the rail, and the tailor has priced the one you like absurdly.

variations.know: The tailor has a suit on the rail in place of a coat.
The coats on the rail are light summer ones, and the weather is warm.
Takemura is choosing a coat for you this time.

stages.label: V and Takemura choose a coat at the tailor
stages.objective: Pick a coat for Takemura at the Wellsprings tailor
stages.know: You are at a tailor boutique in Heywood's Wellsprings with Takemura. The tailor is ready to haggle, and Takemura is watching in silence.
stages.wants: V to pick a coat for him, and to haggle.

done.memory: You went to a tailor in Heywood's Wellsprings with Takemura and helped him choose a coat from three, while he watched the price.
